data.name: Premkumar
data.gender_notes: Premkumar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Prem (Love) + Kumar (God's Son). The name Premkumar carries the meaning “Love God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Premkumar usually hope their child will grow to embody love god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Premkumar belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Love God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Premkumar total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name Premkumar, composed of two Sanskrit words "Prem" meaning love and "Kumar" meaning God's son, suggests a deep and special connection with the divine and the emotion of love. In Hindu culture, this name is a window into the rich tapestry of values that the tradition holds dear - love, devotion, and the divine connection that ties all beings together.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Premkumar lies in its deeper meaning, representing a loving connection to the divine. In Hinduism, the name is a reminder that we are all God's children, and that our ultimate goal is to cultivate and strengthen our connection with our inner divine self and the divine beyond, by embodying the divine qualities of love, compassion, and selfless service.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Premkumar: Love and Work. This name symbolizes a life dedicated to spreading love (Prem) and working hard to fulfill one's duties and aspirations (Kumar).
